app.tagline: Captions, audio description, and image description, drafted on your own computer. By Tech Inclusion Pro.
app.local_chip: Local only. Nothing leaves this computer.
modes.label: Way of working
steps.label: Project steps
media.title: Add media
media.lede: Bring in a video, an audio file, or images. Choose what to make and where the processing happens.
media.formats: Video: MP4, MOV, MKV. Audio: MP3, WAV, M4A. Images: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP. Slides: PDF, PPTX.
intent.title: Say what you want
intent.lede: Before any model runs, tell the app about this video in your own words. Speak or type. Your answers steer every later step.
need.title: Is audio description needed?
need.lede: The app compared what is shown with what is said. Audio description is needed only where important visual information is not already in the audio. You make the final call on every segment.
review.title: Review the draft
review.lede: Every cue is a draft until a person approves it. Flags say where to look first. Each cue can be played, edited, and approved from the keyboard.
export.title: Export
export.lede: Choose the files you need. Every export carries a record of what was drafted by a model and what a person reviewed.
live.title: Live session
live.lede: Live captions and a slide-change announcer, both running on this computer. Live mode does not try to describe people or scenes as they happen. Local models are not yet fast or accurate enough for that.
standards.title: Description standards
standards.lede: Ten criteria for audio description, also called video description. Each one comes from an organization of people with disabilities, quoted and cited. The app checks its drafts against these, and this page ships inside the app.
debug.test_job_hint: Exercises the job queue and progress stream. No models run.
a11y.grip: Move this panel. Drag with a pointer, or press the arrow keys while this button is focused.
a11y.color_hint: These change the palette so colors stay separable. They do not simulate color blindness.
a11y.dyslexic_hint: Some readers prefer it. Research on whether it improves reading speed is mixed, so try it and keep it only if it helps you.
a11y.position_hint: You can also drag the grip at the top of this panel, or focus it and press the arrow keys.
a11y.reset_done: All display settings reset to default
app.foot: DescriptorPro drafts; you decide. The display settings button changes how this app looks and stores your choices on your own device.
media.formats_now: Video: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI. Audio: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG. (Images and slides arrive in Phase 5.)
media.uploading: Copying your file into the project...
media.done_hint: Captions drafted. Opening the Review step.
media.model_hint: Larger models hear better and run slower. The first use of a model downloads it from its official source.
review.empty: No project yet. Add media first; drafted captions appear here for review.
review.name_hint: Approving records your name and the time in the provenance record.
review.no_matches: No cues match the current filters.
export.unreviewed_warning: Only {approved} of {total} cues are approved. Exports will be stamped "DRAFT. Not yet reviewed by a person." until every cue is approved.
